items.title: Ticket Sales Begin for Epic Seven Esports 'E7WC 2026' Finals
items.summary: Smilegate announced that seat reservations for the finals of the Epic Seven World Championship 2026 (E7WC 2026), the global esports tournament for Epic Seven (Epic7), begin on the 16th.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ⓒ Smilegate Smilegate announced that seat reservations for the finals of the Epic Seven World Championship 2026 (E7WC 2026), the global esports tournament for Epic Seven (Epic7), begin on the 16th. The finals will take place at 12:00 PM on the 28th at Lotte Cinema World Tower in Jamsil, Seoul.

The ticketing schedule is divided into a presale based on account level and a general sale open to all players. Players who verify an Epic Seven account level of 70 or higher can participate in the Super Plex theater presale from 8:00 PM to midnight on the 16th. General ticketing will begin at 8:00 PM on the 17th.

The onsite viewing space consists of the Super Plex theater, where players will compete, and one standard auditorium screening the live broadcast. The Super Plex theater features recliner seats for all rows except the front-row bean bag seats, along with Studio seats and Sofa Bed seats. The standard auditorium will broadcast the matches on a large screen with a theater sound system.

Onsite activities outside of watching matches will take place in the 7th and 10th-floor lobbies of the cinema. Cosplay models including Ahyi, Aza, Song Joo-a, and Berry will participate, and a fan creation market featuring a total of 14 creator teams will also be hosted.

Epic Seven is a mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative and published by Smilegate. Detailed information about the game can be found on its official community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ New “Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine” Hero Out Now
Smilegate Devs Speak on Epic Seven's Steam Debut and Chaos Zero Nightmare's Anniversary
items.summary: TWIMG is chock full of interviews this week! Find out what
items.content:
Hello and welcome once more to another edition of This Week in Mobile Games , your twice-monthly look at the wild world of games on your phone and other mobile devices (and more, these days).

Today's installment is a bit special, as I've been learning a bit more about Chaos Zero Nightmare and Epic Seven . Both games are free-to-play titles developed by Smilegate , with Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN) being the newer one. CZN recently launched its first anniversary celebration, and Epic Seven ( E7) commemorated its eighth birthday earlier this year. More recently, though, the game made its debut on Steam for the first time, and a new server based on the platform went live right alongside the 6th annual Epic Seven World Championship.

In light of the new developments for both titles, I had a chance to send a few questions to developers at Smilegate , namely Epic Seven Producer Tak Gwang-Jin, as well as Choi Seung-Hyuin, who recently took on the role of Producer for Chaos Zero Nightmare . They reflected on their respective games, commenting on Chaos Zero Nightmare 's inspirations and the changes it's gone through since its (admittedly rough) launch last year, and on Epic Seven 's long journey and its growing eSports scene.

Chaos Zero Nightmare Producer Choi Seung-Hyuin on the S.S. Nightmare 's Voyage so Far, and its Year Ahead

ANN: Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN) features an unusual premise that blends together cosmic horror and science fantasy elements, alongside mechanics that sometimes rely on characters suffering mental breakdowns in the middle of combat to unleash their most powerful abilities. What works inspired the team at Smilegate to explore this core concept?

CHOI and KIM : It's difficult to name just one. Rather than drawing from any single title, our planning team worked hard to incorporate into CZN the elements each member personally found compelling.

There are specific works that inspired us more than others, but we don't limit ourselves by genre. Whether it's a completely unrelated game, a film, or an anime, the planning team shares what they've enjoyed and works to bring it to life in the game.

CZN employs an art style that employs 2D animation-style characters and cutscenes. How did the team decide on this presentation style compared to full 3D character models and environments (which are increasingly popular among free-to-play games)?

CHOI : Over the course of developing Epic Seven , we built up deep expertise in 2D, and that naturally drew in people who are passionate about 2D illustration. I think that team is what made CZN's 2D presentation possible.

CZN is celebrating its first anniversary and has seen a lot of changes between its launch last year and now. Which changes are you most excited to see go live in the game?

CHOI : Our first anniversary is only the beginning. We've been working to fix the problem of Combatants feeling much less useful once a season ends, and the first improvement will arrive in Season 6. Beyond that, the roguelike content will be revamped, and in Season Chaos, we'll make building Save Data less grindy while adding new challenges. The story will also dive into the tale of the gods with twists no one will see coming. A lot is waiting for players, so we hope they'll stay with us and remain excited through our second anniversary.

What is the biggest lesson the team has learned from player feedback and the experience of CZN's live operations in the year so far?

CHOI: When we didn't have enough time to test something properly, players always let us know. Now we check everything much more carefully. Our schedule is much more manageable, and we believe the service has become a lot more stable.

Mr. Choi, what sort of design philosophy are you hoping to bring to the game's future, and what can players of CZN look forward to from your tenure as its producer?

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ Out Now on Steam, World Championship Knockout Stage Details
items.summary: Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title 'Epic Seven' is now
items.content:
Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ is now available on PC via Steam , joining the STOVE client as a new way to play the game. This launch also marks the launch of a new server dubbed “Foundry”. The publisher writes that the “Steam launch is part of a platform expansion reflecting the needs of global players”. With Epic Seven now available on Steam, the world’s largest gaming platform, long-term positive synergy is expected from a new influx of players and improved accessibility. Furthermore, the Steam server introduces exclusive new features, such as controller support. Additionally, a new Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” is live from 29 October to the 10th of December. The Knockout stage of the World Championships are also underway! Though the gist of that is that for the next few weekends, matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch —beginning at 03:00 UTC. More details on that can be found below. Epic Seven is a free-to-play title that is available across PC (Windows) via Steam / STOVE , iOS (macOS supported), and Android via Google Play .

The new “Foundry” server, launched alongside the Steam service, can be accessed not only through Steam but also via the STOVE PC Client and mobile devices. For players starting Epic Seven for the first time, the new server will operate with independent matchmaking for PvP content for a limited time.

Additionally, various events will be held on the new server to help players settle in quickly. A Settlement Support Buff Event, which began on the 29th, provides various effects to accelerate Hero and account growth, along with daily free Hero summons. There will also be bountiful rewards provided, including various Equipment, growth materials, and Hero Skins, when players log in or play through content.

Global player response has also been highly positive, with over 100,000 players participating in the Steam Wishlist Event that began in August.

Meanwhile, Epic Seven will release a Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” from Oct. 29 to Dec. 10. The greatest Bunny detective, Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro, alongside her sidekick, Alencia, will investigate various incidents to stop a plot detected during a victory celebration party, uncovering the hidden truth behind the case along the way.

Players can earn three pieces of Level 88 Equipment by progressing through the story and will receive a special Pet upon collecting all three new Bunny Girl characters and two skins. Additional rewards, such as Charms and Emojis, can also be earned through the concurrent “Trusty Sidekick Alencia’s Case Files” and “Lucky Board Party!” events.

E7WC determines the ultimate global champion of Epic Seven ‘s real-time PvP mode, World Arena. The Knockout Stage will feature 16 players: the 14 survivors from the two-week Group Stage, along with Hazamarei and MagicQi, who secured their Knockout Stage seeds by placing first and second in the newly established online league, “ Epic Seven Masters 2026.”

The Group Stage, held over four days on October 10 (Sat), 11 (Sun), 17 (Sat), and 18 (Sun), delivered incredible matches and top-tier entertainment for Epic Seven fans. In particular, defending champion XiaoXuenai faced elimination after a loss to FN in the Upper Bracket but rallied to win the final match, proving the resilience of a true champion by advancing to the Knockout Stage. In addition, OMEGA from Group E made headlines with an incredible comeback victory, perfectly utilizing “Salome”—a Hero capable of cloning target Heroes—from a heavily disadvantaged position.

The Knockout Stage will be held every weekend at 03:00 UTC for about four weeks, from October 24 to November 14. Like the Group Stage, it will follow a Double-Elimination format to determine the Top 4 players who will advance to the Finals, held at the Lotte Cinema World Tower SUPER PLEX in Jamsil, Korea, on November 28. All matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch .

Smilegate will run a Drops event for viewers tuning in via Twitch and reveal coupon codes during the live broadcast. Additionally, Smilegate will hold an in-game Match Prediction event, allowing players to predict match results and earn rewards.

Enjoying DayOne ? Do us a favour, and make us a ‘ Preferred Source on Google ‘ – that way, you’ll only be delivered more gaming coverage from our team.

There’s plenty of ways to become a part of DayOne. Head over and let us know your thoughts in the Day O ne Forums , the perfect place to chat about games if you’re a little more old-school and prefer things in a longform form, and if you mainly play on PC, join our Steam Community to connect with other members and maybe make some new friends!

Prefer the chaos of live and fast moving conversation? Come and make some noise in the lively DayOne Community Discord Server instead. If you’re rocking a DayOne Membership, both places give special access for our supporters, and you’ll unlock a ton of exclusive content, just for you.

items.title: Epic Seven Officially Launches on Steam, Opens New Server 'Foundry'
items.summary: Smilegate announced on the 30th that Epic Seven officially launched its Steam service on the 29th and opened the new server 'Foundry'. More than 100,000 players cumulatively participated in the Steam Wishlist event that began last August.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ⓒ Smilegate Smilegate announced on the 30th that Epic Seven officially launched its Steam service on the 29th and opened the new server 'Foundry'. More than 100,000 players cumulatively participated in the Steam Wishlist event that began last August.

Developed by Supercreative, the mobile turn-based strategy RPG Epic Seven expanded its service platform to Steam in response to global player demand. Smilegate explained that it expects long-term synergies in terms of attracting new players and improving accessibility. The Steam service also supports controller/gamepad controls.

The new server, 'Foundry', can also be accessed on mobile and the PC client STOVE. For players starting the game for the first time, PvP (player-versus-player) matchmaking will operate separately from other servers for a set period.

Events have also been prepared to help new players settle into the game. The 'Settlement Support Buff Event' that began on the 29th provides growth support effects for heroes and accounts, as well as daily hero summon opportunities. Rewards for logging into the game and playing content include equipment, growth materials, and hero skins.

The special Side Story 'Secret Rabbit Hole' will run from the 29th through December 10. By progressing through the story, players can earn three types of Level 88 equipment, and collecting all three new bunny girl characters and two skins will grant a special pet.

The narrative follows 'Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro' and her assistant 'Alencia' as they investigate an incident to prevent a terrorist attack detected during a victory party. Over the course of their investigation, the two uncover the full truth behind the hidden event.

During the same period, the 'Trusty Sidekick Alencia's Case Files Event' and the 'Lucky Board Party Event' will offer additional rewards such as enhancement stones and emojis. Detailed information about the game can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Officially Launches on Steam Oct. 29, Opens New Server
items.summary: © SmilegateSmilegate will launch the official Steam service for its mobile turn-based strategy RPG Epic Seven on October 29.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on © Smilegate Smilegate will launch the official Steam service for its mobile turn-based strategy RPG Epic Seven on October 29. Along with opening a new server, the company will hold growth support events and release a Steam demo ahead of the official launch.

On October 8, Smilegate announced the Steam release schedule and key event details for Epic Seven, developed by Super Creative. The new server, "Foundry," added alongside the official service launch, can be accessed not only through Steam but also via the STOVE PC client and mobile devices. Players can also play the game on Steam while retaining their existing account data.

Growth support events for new server players will begin on October 29. The "Settlement Support Buff Event" provides hero and account growth benefits, including a 30% boost to EXP earned. Players who reach Account Level 70 will receive the hero "Luna," and 20 free daily summons will also be provided.

Additionally, an event will reward players with equipment, growth materials, and hero skins based on their cumulative points earned in the PvP mode "Arena." Separate login rewards will also be provided for players.

Ahead of the official service, an Epic Seven demo will be available on Steam from 6:00 PM on October 8 until October 27. Released as part of "2026 Steam Next Fest," the demo allows players to experience main story content alongside major battle modes such as "Brawl," "Battlefield of the War God," and "Automaton Tower". However, gameplay progress made in the demo will not carry over to the official service.

Further details regarding Epic Seven's official Steam service and events can be found on the official community and YouTube channel.

items.title: Mobile RPG Epic Seven Kicks Off Collaboration With Chaos Zero Nightmare, Adding New Heroes and Roguelike Content
items.summary: Mobile RPG Epic Seven has begun a collaboration with Smilegate
items.content:
Mobile RPG Epic Seven, serviced by Smilegate Megaport and developed by SUPER CREATIVE, has begun a collaboration with Chaos Zero Nightmare, a popular IP of Smilegate Megaport's own — the companies announced the crossover on Friday, September 18.

Chaos Zero Nightmare is a dark fantasy roguelike RPG serviced by Smilegate. The game has won strong popularity among users for its striking presentation depicting characters' mental breakdowns and traumas, combined with its original card-based roguelike battle system.

During the collaboration period, running from Thursday, September 17 to 11:59 AM on Thursday, October 29, a special side story will be released, and Chaos Zero Nightmare's main combatants will appear as heroes in Epic Seven. A range of commemorative events will also be held alongside it.

The limited side story "Star's Journey: The Road Home" (星の旅路：家への道) depicts an adventure in which Renoa (レノア), Haru (ハル), and Mei Lin (メイリン) from the world of Chaos Zero Nightmare suddenly find themselves lost in Epic Seven's world of Orbis (オルビス), and set out to find their way home with the help of Vivian (ヴィヴィアン), the leader of the massive city of Witchaven (ウィッチヘイヴン).

In the first week, Haru and Renoa will appear as heroes in Epic Seven. The limited hero Haru is a 5-star Ice-attribute Warrior who grants allies a shield and 不屈 (an effect that boosts survivability) to help them endure, while unleashing a powerful attack that pierces a single enemy's defense. Renoa is a 5-star Dark-attribute Archer whose unique 鎮魂の弾丸 (an effect she applies to herself) increases her Speed and Critical Hit Damage, dealing stronger damage the more stacks she has. Renoa can also be obtained through a special login event.

Various events are also being held to celebrate the collaboration. The login event will distribute various growth materials, including the collaboration hero Renoa. In addition, a new Daily Epione Center (デイリーエピオネセンター) feature recreating Chaos Zero Nightmare's Epione Center (エピオネセンター) system will be added, letting players enjoy the collaboration heroes' individual stories through the event while also earning rewards such as unique equipment.

Epic Seven has also officially launched its first roguelike content, Dimensional Exploration (次元探索). In this mode, players explore a map using up to seven heroes and take on bosses across three tiers of floors, with choices at forks in the path, the use of relics, and hero formations all shaping a variety of possible outcomes based on the player's decisions. Season 1 is themed around the Chaos Zero Nightmare collaboration, with future seasons planned around a variety of other themes.

The Epic Seven app can be downloaded from the Google Play Store and the App Store. More information about Epic Seven is available through the official community and the official YouTube channel.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stove.epic7.google

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1322399438

Genre: 未来につなげるアニメRPG (an anime RPG connecting to the future)

Price: Free-to-play (in-app purchases available)

Official Website: https://epic7.onstove.com/ja/brand

Official Community: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/jp

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.

items.title: Epic Seven Review
items.summary: Epic Seven comes about as close to breaking the mold as I've ever seen. Although it does this at the cost of incorporating some gameplay mechanics better
items.content:
Though Epic Seven is worth a download, you're going to have to try it for yourself to see if it's worth the space on your phone.

What are some of the first things that come to mind when you think of mobile gacha games? Shallow gameplay, incessant power creep, and punishing summoning systems pretty much top the list for anyone even vaguely familiar with the genre. Some of the gaming industry’s worst practices are synonymous with gachas, and even the most respected gacha titles in the market can’t shake all the genre’s shortcomings.

Fire Emblem Heroes is still one of the biggest poster children for unbridled power creep despite Intelligent Systems’ improvements to the game following its release. Fate Grand Order distinguishes itself from its peers through excellent aesthetics and well-crafted narratives. But even after receiving six years of updates, its gameplay mechanics remain archaic, and its summoning system lacks many quality of life changes adopted by its contemporaries. Two steps backward almost always follow each step forward, and it’s almost impossible to find a title that doesn’t choose to die on one of these hills of gacha vices.

Epic Seven comes about as close to breaking the mold as I’ve ever seen. Although it does this at the cost of incorporating some gameplay mechanics better suited to an MMORPG than a mobile game, it proves an interesting if not worthwhile experience. Your mileage may vary, but the game’s appealing visuals, welcome summoning system, and sprawling amount of content make it worth taking a hard look at.

Epic Seven is a turn-based RPG in which you build teams of up to four heroes. Each hero is associated with one of five elements: earth, ice, fire, light, and dark. The latter two elements are vulnerable to each other, while the first three are strong or weak against one another in a rock-paper-scissors arrangement. Heroes also come in various classes. For example, thieves embody the archetype of high damage output but low survivability, and soul weavers fill the healer role while offering supporting abilities such as team resurrection. I recommend a balanced team of a tank, two damage dealers, and a healer for general PvE content. Still, the classes offer enough flexibility to support plenty of experimentation.

Every hero boasts two basic skills and an ultimate skill. While you may assume this skill system is shallow at first glance, the limited skill selection makes gameplay more cohesive and tight-knit. Every skill feels impactful, from basic skills to high-end ultimate abilities. Buffs and debuffs attached to most skills enhance this feeling. They often result in extreme damage and healing numbers that leave you supremely satisfied, and they can make lower-rarity heroes just as fun to use as five-star ones. For example, defense break, a common debuff, reduces a target’s defense by a massive 70%!

Sadly, Epic Seven ‘s story is not its selling point. You play as Ras Elclare, a human avatar of a faction of benevolent gods. Thanks to certain malevolent gods, Ras’ world is trapped in a cycle of constant destruction and rebirth. He journeys to end this vicious cycle once and for all. Unfortunately, the game’s meager writing and unwillingness to see certain plot twists through mar the story. After its introductory chapters, the game wraps consequential plot points in a noticeable layer of armor it refuses to shed, making the journey feel more like a long tutorial than an engaging piece of fiction. The campaign improves as you progress, but by and large, Epic Seven ‘s narrative goes in one ear and out the other.

Fortunately, you can sink your teeth into a lot more than the campaign. On the PvE end of things, you can dive into standard material/equipment grinding maps. Or you can explore sprawling labyrinths with a clever morale system that keeps you from steamrolling the entire map in one go. If you’re looking to test your team to its limit, you can try to clear Automaton Tower and Abyss, which handsomely reward you if your team is up to the task. Side stories — temporarily available sidequests — provide additional story content, though they amount to little more than snippets of lore and some extra loot.

Arena mode provides most of the game’s PvP content. In arena, you battle against other players’ teams to climb the ranks. You can also battle other players in real-time in the world arena. After joining a guild, those who prefer teamwork can participate in guild wars, a slightly modified version of arena with rarer rewards.

The absence of significant power creep among new heroes helps keep gameplay balanced. In fact, many of the most powerful characters to this day have been available since close to release. Generally speaking, the design philosophy behind new heroes focuses on breadth and emphasizes new combat styles or fresh takes on already-existing ones.

Epic Seven has you covered even if you enjoy the hero-collecting aspect of gacha games over their actual gameplay. You earn skystones, the game’s premium currency, through quests, campaign progression, and in-game events. You mainly use skystones to acquire covenant bookmarks, a currency you can spend to summon new heroes. Though you can trade skystones for bookmarks directly, players seeking to maximize efficiency may want to use skystones to refresh the secret shop on the home screen. By doing so, you can usually acquire bookmarks at a more favorable rate. The game also incentivizes you to refresh the secret shop by giving each refresh a chance to yield mystic medals. You can use mystic medals to obtain rarer light and dark heroes, though doing so significantly dents your reserves of gold.

The game’s normal banners — events that offer boosted odds of summoning certain heroes — are similarly generous. Though they only offer a 1% chance to summon a specified five-star hero (that banner’s “rate-up” hero), you’re guaranteed to summon the hero after 120 summons. What’s more, when you net a five-star hero, the banner ensures the hero you summon is its rate-up hero. As a result, you no longer need to worry about summoning pity breakers, unwanted five-star heroes that reset enhanced summoning odds. With just a bit of research on banner rotations and three to four weeks of diligent saving, you can grab any five-star hero that isn’t light or dark.

It’s a shame that the game locks five-star light and dark heroes behind more demanding summoning systems. You’ll have to save currency for months to obtain these heroes. Fortunately, they’re only relevant in PvP, and completing the campaign rewards you with one of six powerful, meta-relevant light and dark five-star heroes. So you’re not entirely out of luck if you’re interested in five-star heroes of the light or dark variety.

Epic Seven hits the brakes on the fun train once you get to its hero leveling and upgrade systems. Leveling demands extensive grinding, and you can take very few shortcuts to dodge this bullet. You also need to promote heroes to six stars to reach their maximum potential, which requires sacrificing five other five-star heroes. The game offers heroes designed for sacrifice, so you don’t need to burn through all your precious summons to obtain six-star ones. However, these sacrificial heroes mostly come in two, three, or four-star rarities, meaning you have to grind to promote them to five stars first.
